$operator.summary: Pancreator self-development verification commands grouped by workflow purpose.
$operator.note: This template applies only when developing Pancreator itself. Embedded installations receive repository-checks.json instead.

configuration.description: Validate Pancreator governance, workflow, and projection configuration.

static.description: Run Pancreator formatting, type, and lint checks, including the Bash shell check (bin/check-shell: bash -n under /bin/bash over bin/ and .githooks/, plus shellcheck -S error when installed).

fast.description: Run Pancreator's compiled unit and regression lanes. The integration lane runs only before release, in the full profile.

impacted.description: Iteration profile, never a gate: select and run only the lane tests whose static import closure reaches the changed files. Implementing agents submit after it passes and leave fast to the gates.

impacted-integration.description: Interior gate before verify: run the integration tests whose static import closure reaches any file this branch changed against pan-dev, plus the dirty tree. The full profile at the ship gate still runs every lane.

impacted-release.description: Release-landing default: the touch-set rule. Run every lane test whose static import closure reaches a file the candidate changed against pan-dev, covering unit, integration, and regression at once. Replaces full as pan release land's default gate; an operator who needs full or another profile for a specific land still gets it with --verify-profile. Ignores the release metadata paths a land's own finalize step rewrites, so the version bump every land carries never triggers the whole-lane global-file fallback.
commands: ./bin/pan tests impacted --changed pan-dev --ignore VERSION --ignore CHANGELOG.md --ignore package.json --ignore package-lock.json --ignore release/index.json --ignore docs/embedded-installation.md

secondary.description: Run Pancreator's installer suites, which are outside the default lane.

full.description: Run complete documented verification: the aggregate lint/build/validate check, coverage thresholds, and the deterministic installer smoke harness. The coverage run executes every test lane once, so no lane runs twice.
